records.name: Nmap
records.purpose: Discover hosts, open ports and service details within an authorised scope.
records.safeUse: Use only against systems you own or have explicit permission to assess.

records.name: Wireshark
records.purpose: Inspect network packets and troubleshoot protocols or suspicious traffic.
records.safeUse: Capture traffic only on networks and devices where monitoring is authorised.

records.name: tcpdump
records.purpose: Capture and inspect network packets from a command line.
records.safeUse: Limit captures to authorised interfaces and avoid collecting unrelated personal data.

records.name: Zeek
records.purpose: Generate structured network logs for traffic analysis and detection.
records.safeUse: Use in a monitored environment with appropriate privacy and retention controls.

records.name: Suricata
records.purpose: Detect suspicious network activity using signatures and protocol analysis.
records.safeUse: Begin with monitoring or test traffic before enabling inline blocking.

records.name: Snort
records.purpose: Inspect traffic and detect patterns that match configured rules.
records.safeUse: Tune rules against known-good traffic to reduce false positives.

records.name: OWASP ZAP
records.purpose: Test web applications for common security weaknesses in a controlled environment.
records.safeUse: Use the passive scanner first; actively test only applications in scope.

records.name: Burp Suite
records.purpose: Proxy and inspect web requests during authorised application testing.
records.safeUse: Use only against permitted targets and avoid testing production data without approval.

records.name: Nikto
records.purpose: Check web servers for known risky files, outdated software and misconfiguration.
records.safeUse: Scanning can create load and alerts; obtain written scope first.

records.name: testssl.sh
records.purpose: Review TLS versions, ciphers and certificate configuration.
records.safeUse: Run against systems you administer or are authorised to assess.

records.name: OpenSSL
records.purpose: Inspect certificates and test TLS connections using standard cryptographic utilities.
records.safeUse: Protect private keys and never paste secret key material into public tools.

records.name: Trivy
records.purpose: Scan container images, filesystems, repositories and configuration for known issues.
records.safeUse: Review findings and verify remediation before changing production systems.

records.name: Grype
records.purpose: Identify known vulnerabilities in container images and filesystems.
records.safeUse: Validate package matches and prioritize fixes based on context.

records.name: Syft
records.purpose: Generate a software bill of materials for images and filesystems.
records.safeUse: Treat inventories as potentially sensitive because they reveal component versions.

records.name: Semgrep
records.purpose: Find code patterns associated with bugs and security issues.
records.safeUse: Review findings manually; static analysis can produce false positives.

records.name: Gitleaks
records.purpose: Detect likely credentials and secrets committed to Git repositories.
records.safeUse: If a real secret is exposed, revoke and rotate it rather than only deleting it.

records.name: OSV-Scanner
records.purpose: Check project dependencies against the Open Source Vulnerabilities database.
records.safeUse: Confirm affected versions and upgrade paths before remediation.

records.name: YARA
records.purpose: Match files or memory content against analyst-defined pattern rules.
records.safeUse: Use isolated analysis environments and trusted rule sources.

records.name: ClamAV
records.purpose: Scan files for known malware signatures and suspicious content.
records.safeUse: Keep signatures current and do not treat a clean scan as proof of safety.

records.name: Velociraptor
records.purpose: Collect endpoint evidence and investigate suspicious activity across systems.
records.safeUse: Apply least privilege, approved collection scopes and evidence-handling procedures.

records.name: osquery
records.purpose: Query endpoint state using SQL-like tables for investigation and inventory.
records.safeUse: Use approved queries and consider performance and privacy impact.

records.name: Sigma
records.purpose: Write portable detection rules that can be translated for supported SIEM platforms.
records.safeUse: Test rules against representative logs and document false-positive conditions.

records.name: MITRE ATT&CK
records.purpose: Map observed behaviours to documented adversary tactics and techniques.
records.safeUse: Treat ATT&CK mapping as an analytic aid, not proof that an actor is identified.

records.name: CyberChef
records.purpose: Decode, transform and inspect data through a browser-based recipe workflow.
records.safeUse: Do not upload confidential or sensitive evidence to public instances.
